name: Streax Professional Shampoo 300ml Argan Secrets MOISTURISING Shampoo for Women | Enriched with Argan Oil & UV Filter | Enhances Colour Retention | Cleanses & Nourishes Hair | Made in BD
description:
Streax Professional Argan Secrets Moisturising Shampoo – 300ml
Product of Bangladesh

Maintain vibrant, healthy-coloured hair with Streax Professional Argan Secrets Moisturising Shampoo. Enriched with Argan Oil and UV filters, this shampoo cleanses, nourishes, and helps protect the colour and shine of your hair. Suitable for both men and women, it delivers smooth, lustrous, and radiant hair.

Key Features & Benefits:

Colour Protection: Advanced Colour Reinforcer Technology and UV protection help maintain the vibrancy of coloured hair for longer.

Nourishing Formula: Enriched with Argan Oil to strengthen, hydrate, and soften hair.

Smoothness & Shine: Improves hair texture, leaving it silky, smooth, and radiant.

Gentle Care for Coloured Hair: Designed specifically for coloured hair, ideal for post-colouring care.

Suited for Indian Hair Types: Developed with international technology tailored for Indian hair needs.

Size: 300ml
Target Gender: Unisex
Made in Bangladesh

Perfect for daily use, this shampoo keeps coloured hair nourished, shiny, and vibrant while protecting it from fading.
